headings.title: County venue for probate and administration
headings.reviewNote: Establishes venue rules for probating wills and granting letters based on decedent domicile, property, or legal rights.

headings.title: Stay of multi-county proceedings and priority
headings.reviewNote: Requires staying proceedings in subsequent counties pending venue determination in the county where first commenced.

headings.title: Jurisdiction over subsequent estate proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Requires all orders, settlements, trials, and estate proceedings to occur in the county where letters were granted.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.010 governing probate venue rules, priority of first commenced proceedings, and exclusive county forum for estate administration.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of letters application
headings.reviewNote: Specifies ten required disclosure categories including decedent particulars, heirs, property values, will copies, and administration type.

headings.title: Supplementary disclosure of omitted information
headings.reviewNote: Requires personal representatives or interested persons to promptly file written amendments if application disclosures were omitted or inaccurate.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.017 detailing application disclosures for letters testamentary or of administration and subsequent corrective filings.

headings.title: Petition by interested persons or creditors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes interested persons or creditors to petition for letters or probate if no application is filed within twenty days.

headings.title: One-year petition deadline and required contents
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing the petition within one year after death and listing decedent details, designated personal representatives if a will was presented, and known heirs.

headings.title: Fifteen-day hearing, notice, and disposition orders
headings.reviewNote: Sets a hearing within fifteen days on who should apply for letters (not claim validity), requires court-directed notice, and authorizes orders directing application, refusing letters, or dismissing.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.020 governing interested-person petitions after twenty days, one-year filing deadline and required contents, and fifteen-day hearings and disposition orders.

headings.title: Mandatory delivery of will to court
headings.reviewNote: Requires a will custodian after death to deliver the will to the probate division with jurisdiction or where the will is found (which copies and mails the original by certified mail).

headings.title: Will found in bank safe deposit box
headings.reviewNote: Deems wills found in safe deposit boxes to be in the depository's custody for section 473.043 and permits the depository to make a copy before delivery.

headings.title: Court summons, attachment, and commitment for refusal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the probate division to summon any person refusing to produce a will in their possession and compel production by attachment and commitment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.043 governing custodian will delivery, safe deposit box depository custody and copying, and court summons, attachment, and commitment for refusal.

headings.title: Presentment and admission required for effective will
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a will must be presented for and admitted to probate to be effective as a will.

headings.title: Statutory definition of will presentment
headings.reviewNote: Defines "presented" for chapters 472–475 as delivering the will (or verified statement if unavailable) together with a section 473.097 affidavit, probate petition, or authenticated out-of-state probate order.

headings.title: Time limitations for presenting will for probate
headings.reviewNote: Bars taking proof or issuing a probate certificate unless presented within six months of first letters notice (or 30 days of a section 473.083 contest), one year of death if no notice, or during domiciliary administration.

headings.title: Proof and administration after timely presentment
headings.reviewNote: Permits a will presented within subsection 3 time limits to be proven and administered at any time after presentment.

headings.title: Permanent bar against untimely wills
headings.reviewNote: Forever bars from admission to probate in Missouri any will not presented within the subsection 3 time limits.

headings.title: One-year deadline for letters of administration
headings.reviewNote: Bars issuing letters of administration unless applied for within one year of death, except as provided in subsection 4 and section 537.021.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.050 governing required probate presentment, definition of presentment, statutory time limits, post-presentment proof, permanent bar of untimely wills, and the one-year deadline for letters of administration.

headings.title: Subscribing witness testimony and affidavits
headings.reviewNote: Requires testimony or affidavits of subscribing witnesses to prove due execution and testamentary capacity.

headings.title: Proof of handwriting when witnesses unavailable
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes proving a will through handwriting evidence of the testator and witnesses when witnesses are dead or unavailable.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.053 governing subscribing witness testimony and alternative handwriting proof for deceased witnesses.

headings.title: Recording testimony of will witnesses
headings.reviewNote: Requires all testimony given in support of a will to be reduced to writing and recorded by the clerk.

headings.title: Admissibility of recorded testimony in evidence
headings.reviewNote: Makes certified copies of recorded witness testimony admissible in subsequent will contests when witnesses cannot attend.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.063 governing mandatory recording of witness testimony and its admissibility in subsequent will contest proceedings.

headings.title: Probate of self-proved will without further proof
headings.reviewNote: Directs probating without further proof any will appearing to have required signatures and a section 474.337 self-proving certificate meeting section 474.320.

headings.title: Contest procedure under section 473.083
headings.reviewNote: Provides that procedure to contest a will probated under subsection 1 shall be as provided in section 473.083.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.065 governing probate of self-proved wills without further proof and cross-reference to section 473.083 contest procedures.

headings.title: Time limit to establish interest by descent
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing any action to establish an estate interest by descent before expiration of the objection period for a section 473.590 final settlement or section 473.840(4) statement of account.

headings.title: Mother's right to file for posthumous heir in gestation
headings.reviewNote: Grants the mother of an unborn alleged heir in gestation the right to file a subsection 1 action on the alleged heir's behalf.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.070 governing deadlines to establish an interest by descent and a mother's right to file for an unborn heir in gestation (source notes cite 1996 Nocita and 2000 Johnson v. Akers).

headings.title: Findings required for admission of will to probate
headings.reviewNote: Directs admitting a presented will to probate if the clerk or court finds the testator is dead, the will was lawfully executed, and it was not revoked.

headings.title: Determination of testacy or intestacy on application
headings.reviewNote: Directs the clerk or court on an application for letters to determine testacy or intestacy and grant letters accordingly, or deny the application on proper grounds.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.073 governing findings required to admit a will to probate and determination of testacy or intestacy on applications for letters.

headings.title: Finality of probated will absent contest
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that unappealed orders admitting or rejecting wills become binding upon expiration of contest periods.

headings.title: Guardian ad litem for minor or incapacitated party
headings.reviewNote: Requires appointing a guardian ad litem to file or join a will contest within the subsection 1 period when a minor or mentally incapacitated interested person's interest warrants it.

headings.title: Nonjoinder of unaffected persons and binding effect
headings.reviewNote: Dispenses with joining persons not adversely affected and provides that unjoined persons are not bound and have no rights in subsection 8 dismissal consideration, subject to section 472.300.

headings.title: Circuit clerk notice and transmittal to probate division
headings.reviewNote: Requires the circuit clerk upon petition filing to immediately notify the probate division and transmit a copy of the petition within ten days.

headings.title: Circuit judge hearing, probate transfer, and civil rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires hearing before another circuit judge unless transferred to the probate division with the probate judge's consent, governed by the Missouri Rules of Civil Procedure and Civil Code.

headings.title: Ninety-day service deadline and dismissal for default
headings.reviewNote: Requires diligent service of process on all defendants within ninety days of filing, mandating dismissal at petitioner's cost on motion absent good cause.

headings.title: Framing of issues, jury or court trial, and finality
headings.reviewNote: Frames testacy and will issues for trial by jury (or court if no jury demanded), making the verdict or judgment final subject to new trial and appeal rights.

headings.title: Voluntary dismissal by consent after contest period
headings.reviewNote: Permits voluntary dismissal after the contest period by consent of all non-defaulting parties prior to final judgment without requiring court compromise approval under sections 473.084–473.085.

headings.title: Resumption of probate administration after dismissal
headings.reviewNote: Directs the probate judge to proceed with estate administration under the prior probate or rejection order if the contest is dismissed under subsection 6 or 8.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 9 subsection headings for 473.083 governing will finality and six-month contest deadlines, guardian ad litem appointments, nonjoinder, clerk transmittal, circuit judge hearings, 90-day service dismissal, jury/court trials, voluntary dismissal without compromise approval, and resumption of probate after dismissal.

headings.title: Discretionary refusal of letters for small estates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to refuse letters where assets do not exceed exempt property or allowances, or creditor claims under fifteen thousand dollars.

headings.title: Evidentiary proof and refusal order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes hearings on estate value and issuance of refusal orders subject to reopening upon discovering additional property.

headings.title: Collection authority of surviving spouse, children, or creditor
headings.reviewNote: Empowers spouses, minor children, or creditors under refusal orders to collect and sue for estate personal property.

headings.title: Transfer of real estate under refusal order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes recording certified refusal orders with county recorders to establish title to real estate without administration.

headings.title: Creditor debt payment obligations and asset retention
headings.reviewNote: Governs retention of property by spouses and children, and requires creditors to pay debts in statutory preference order.

headings.title: Subrogation rights of funeral and debt payers
headings.reviewNote: Deems persons paying funeral costs or decedent debts to be creditors subrogated to statutory rights under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.090 detailing grounds for refusal of letters, proof, collection powers, real estate title recording, creditor payment orders, and funeral subrogation.

headings.title: Conditions for small estate distribution without letters
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes defeasible title and distribution without letters when estates do not exceed forty thousand dollars and thirty days have elapsed.

headings.title: Affidavit requirements and clerk certificate
headings.reviewNote: Specifies mandatory disclosures in small estate affidavits regarding heirs, debts, property items, and valuations.

headings.title: Filing and furnishing of affidavit copies
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing affidavits and certificates in the probate division and furnishing certified copies to applicants.

headings.title: Recording affidavit to establish real estate title
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes distributees to establish their right to succeed to real estate by filing a copy of the affidavit and clerk's certificate with the recorder of deeds in each county where the land lies.

headings.title: Published notice to creditors for estates over $15,000
headings.reviewNote: Requires two weeks of newspaper publication of a statutory creditor notice form when listed property exceeds $15,000, with proof of publication filed within ten days.

headings.title: Exemption from execution and secured creditor rights
headings.reviewNote: Bars execution against small estate property for decedent debts upon compliance, establishes distributee succession as if fully administered, and preserves secured creditors' rights.

headings.title: Collection, liquidation, abatement, and distribution by affiant
headings.reviewNote: Requires the affiant to collect property, liquidate as needed to pay debts (applying section 473.620 abatement if insufficient), and distribute remaining property, with permissive liquidation to facilitate distribution.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsection headings for 473.097 governing $40,000 small estate conditions, affidavit contents and clerk certificate, filing, real estate recording, published creditor notice over $15,000, execution exemption and secured creditor rights, and affiant collection, liquidation, abatement, and distribution.

headings.title: Grant of letters testamentary to will-named representatives
headings.reviewNote: Directs granting letters testamentary to representatives designated in the will, or to remaining designated or other qualified persons if designated persons are unsuitable, disqualified, or fail to apply.

headings.title: Priority for letters of administration, nomination, and renunciation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes priority for letters of administration (spouse, distributees, or another suitable person) and allows eligible adults to nominate a qualified person or renounce in writing.

headings.title: Eligibility of nonresident persons and corporate fiduciaries
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing an otherwise qualified nonresident natural person or corporate fiduciary as a personal representative.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.110 governing letters testamentary to will-named representatives, letters of administration priority/nomination/renunciation, and nonresident/corporate fiduciary eligibility.

headings.title: Statutory disqualifications for individual representatives
headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies full-time judges and court clerks (except for spouse or third-degree relatives), minors, persons of unsound mind, persons under crime-related legal disability, habitual drunkards, foreign corporations/banks (except under § 362.600), and a personal representative of a personal representative.

headings.title: Presumption and removal when corporate employee drafted will
headings.reviewNote: Presumes a corporate representative's salaried employee did not prepare the will, but allows heirs or devisees to rebut the presumption (absent an independent-counsel recital) and permits removal.

headings.title: Resident agent designation for nonresident representatives
headings.reviewNote: Requires nonresident personal representatives to appoint a resident agent for service of process before receiving letters.

headings.title: Mail service of process and thirty-day response period
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes serving nonresident or foreign corporate representatives by registered, certified, or fallback first-class mail or other state law methods, allowing at least thirty days to appear or respond.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.117 governing personal representative disqualifications (source notes cite 1987 Foxworth on felony convictions), corporate employee will-drafting presumptions and removal, resident agent designation, and mail service with a 30-day response period.

headings.title: Grant of administration to disinterested named executor
headings.reviewNote: Requires granting letters of administration pending a will contest to the named executor upon bond if the executor has no beneficial interest beyond statutory compensation.

headings.title: Discretionary appointment when executor has adverse interest
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court, if the named executor has an interest adverse to a contestant, to grant letters of administration to a disinterested person or corporation upon bond.

headings.title: Administration duties, real estate management, and accounting
headings.reviewNote: Directs the administrator pending contest to administer the estate, manage decedent's in-state real estate as ordered, and account to the qualified executor or administrator when the contest ends.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.137 governing appointment of disinterested named executors or disinterested substitutes pending will contest, real estate management, and accounting.

headings.title: Mandatory revocation of letters upon will probate
headings.reviewNote: Requires revoking letters of administration if a valid will is subsequently found and admitted to probate.

headings.title: Revocation of letters when will probate set aside
headings.reviewNote: Requires revoking letters testamentary and granting other letters of unadministered goods if a proved will's probate is afterward set aside.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.143 governing mandatory revocation of intestate letters upon finding a will and revocation of letters testamentary when probate is set aside.

headings.title: Appointment of administrator de bonis non
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing an administrator de bonis non if all personal representatives die, resign, or are removed before completion.

headings.title: Letters after discharge upon discovering unadministered assets
headings.reviewNote: Permits granting letters for newly discovered unadministered assets after discharge if unpaid allowed claims or other good cause exist, requiring prompt final settlement.

headings.title: Duties and liabilities of administrator de bonis non
headings.reviewNote: Subjects any administrator appointed under section 473.147 to like duties and liabilities as a former executor or administrator.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.147 governing administrators de bonis non upon vacancy, post-discharge letters for newly discovered assets (source notes cite 1977 Waller), and equivalent duties and liabilities.

headings.title: Testamentary compensation, renunciation, and minimum schedule
headings.reviewNote: Makes will compensation controlling unless renounced before qualifying, and sets the 5%–2% tiered minimum percentage schedule plus additional reasonable compensation without requiring extraordinary services.

headings.title: Aggregate compensation and apportionment for multiple representatives
headings.reviewNote: Caps aggregate compensation for joint or successor representatives at twice the minimum schedule or 5% (with real-property possession and extraordinary-service exceptions) and directs apportionment.

headings.title: Minimum attorney compensation and attorney-representative limits
headings.reviewNote: Applies the subsection 1 minimum schedule and reasonable additional compensation to estate attorneys, restricts dual fees for attorney representatives unless authorized or consented to, and limits same-firm representation to one fee.

headings.title: Employment and compensation of accountants and tax specialists
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes employing independent accountants, CPAs, or Treasury-permitted tax specialists for reasonable court-determined fees, with authorization/consent and single-fee limits for accountant representatives.

headings.title: Disallowance of fees for improper accountant services
headings.reviewNote: Bars any accountant fee if the court finds an accountant's services or actions are wrong, improper, or injurious to the estate.

headings.title: Partial or final fee allowance and misconduct reductions
headings.reviewNote: Permits partial or final fee allowances, authorizes denying or reducing representative fees for failure to discharge duties, and bars attorney fees for wrong, improper, or injurious services.

headings.title: Attorney representation in court and self-filed settlements
headings.reviewNote: Requires nonattorney personal representatives to appear in court by a non-salaried attorney, while allowing any personal representative to prepare and file inventories and settlements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsection headings for 473.153 governing testamentary/minimum percentage compensation schedules, joint/successor aggregate caps, estate attorney fees, accountant/tax specialist employment, disallowance for improper accountant services, partial/final allowances and misconduct reductions, and court attorney representation.

headings.title: Minimum attorney fees in first class counties and St. Louis City
headings.reviewNote: Allows estate attorneys in first class counties and St. Louis City minimum fees per section 473.153(1) and additional reasonable compensation without requiring extraordinary service.

headings.title: Limits on legal fees for attorney personal representatives
headings.reviewNote: Bars legal fee allowances for an attorney representative unless authorized by will, court order, or adversely affected heirs/devisees, and limits same-firm dual roles to one subsection 1 fee.

headings.title: Employment and compensation of accountants and tax specialists
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes employing accountants, CPAs, or Treasury-permitted tax specialists for reasonable court-determined fees, with authorization/consent and single-fee limits for accountant representatives.

headings.title: Exemption for attorneys employed by public administrator
headings.reviewNote: Exempts attorneys employed by any duly elected public administrator who is an attorney from subsection 2 fee restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.155 governing minimum attorney fees in first class counties and St. Louis City, attorney-representative limits, accountant/tax specialist employment, and the exemption for public administrator attorneys.

headings.title: Mandatory bond filing and penal sum calculation
headings.reviewNote: Requires personal representatives to file surety bonds approved by the court in penal sums protecting estate personalty.

headings.title: Statutory conditions of fiduciary bond
headings.reviewNote: Specifies bond conditions ensuring faithful performance, perfect inventory, accounting, and lawful distribution of assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.157 governing mandatory bond execution, penal sum calculations, and statutory fiduciary conditions.

headings.title: Testamentary waiver of fiduciary bond
headings.reviewNote: Dispenses with bond requirements when a will expressly directs that no bond be required, unless the court finds cause.

headings.title: Deposit of assets in restricted bank custody
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reducing or dispensing with bonds when estate securities or funds are deposited in restricted bank custody.

headings.title: Bond exemption for section 362.590 certified corporations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts from bond requirements any corporation holding a Missouri director of finance certificate of compliance with section 362.590 at appointment.

headings.title: Dispensing with bond upon good cause shown
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no bond shall be required if the court finds, upon good cause shown, that a bond is unnecessary to protect interested parties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.160 governing testamentary bond waivers, restricted depositary bond reductions, section 362.590 corporate bond exemptions, and dispensing with bond for good cause.

headings.title: Surety appearance and consent to jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Deems execution of a fiduciary bond as an appearance submitting the surety to court jurisdiction in estate proceedings.

headings.title: Summary determination of damages against surety
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to summarily determine and enforce damages against obligors on bonds without separate civil action.

headings.title: Preclusion of surety defense and right of intervention
headings.reviewNote: Precludes sureties from denying liability once fiduciary breach is determined, but allows intervention at liability hearings.

headings.title: Application to restricted custodial depositaries
headings.reviewNote: Applies summary enforcement and damage procedures to depositaries executing restricted asset custody certifications.

headings.title: Apportionment of damages between surety and depositary
headings.reviewNote: Directs apportioning damages between fiduciaries, sureties, and depositaries based on causation and custody breaches.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 473.207 governing surety jurisdictional submission, summary damage enforcement, preclusion rules, depositary liability, and loss apportionment.

headings.title: Thirty-day inventory filing and property classification
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a verified inventory within thirty days classifying real estate, personalty, stocks, notes, and unowned assets.

headings.title: Appointment of disinterested qualified appraisers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing qualified appraisers to determine fair market values of assets where valuation is doubtful.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.233 establishing thirty-day inventory filing schedules, property categories, and appraiser appointments.

headings.title: Representative duty to take possession of personalty
headings.reviewNote: Directs personal representatives to take possession of all decedent personal property except statutory exempt items.

headings.title: Possession, management, and repair of real estate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court orders directing representatives to manage real estate, collect rents, maintain repairs, and pay taxes.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.263 establishing representative possession of personal property and court-ordered real estate management.

headings.title: Title conveyance to executor in trust
headings.reviewNote: Directs conveying purchased real estate to representatives in trust for creditors and heirs, or directly to devisees.

headings.title: Administration and sale of acquired real property
headings.reviewNote: Classifies acquired real estate as estate assets subject to administration, leasing, or sale under court order.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.283 governing trust conveyances of purchased real estate and asset administration standards.

headings.title: Court order to redeem encumbered property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering redemption of mortgaged or pledged real or personal property when beneficial to the estate.

headings.title: Consent required to redeem obligations not yet due
headings.reviewNote: Bars compelling redemption of property securing an undue obligation without the holder's consent unless a claim is filed or the instrument permits redemption.

headings.title: Court-ordered sale of decedent's interest in security
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to order the sale of all of the decedent's right, title, and interest in the security under general estate sale procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.287 governing court-ordered redemption of encumbered property, consent required for undue obligations, and sale of the decedent's security interest.

headings.title: Petition for specific execution of contract
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes buyers or representatives to petition the probate court for specific execution of decedent real estate contracts.

headings.title: Procedure and administrator ad litem when representative is buyer
headings.reviewNote: Allows a personal representative who is the other contract party to proceed against a copersonal representative or requires court appointment of an administrator ad litem.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.303 governing petitions for specific execution of decedent contracts and administrator ad litem appointment when the personal representative is the other party.

headings.title: Judicial finding and order for specific execution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering specific execution and conveyance if contract validity, payment, and performance are proved.

headings.title: Deed recitals, required warranties, and estate liability
headings.reviewNote: Requires the deed to reference the court order, be acknowledged, and include contract-required warranties binding the estate but not the representative personally.

headings.title: Conveyance or lease without court order under will power
headings.reviewNote: Permits a personal representative empowered by will to execute a conveyance or lease upon contract performance without court order.

headings.title: Deed as effectual as execution by decedent
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a deed executed under section 473.310 is as effectual as if executed by the decedent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.310 governing specific execution orders, deed recitals and estate-binding warranties, conveyances or leases without court order under will powers, and legal effect as if executed by the decedent.

headings.title: Completing decedent purchase contracts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes personal representatives to complete decedent real property purchase contracts upon court authorization.

headings.title: Exercise or relinquishment of purchase options
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to direct exercising or abandoning decedent options to purchase real or personal property.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.317 authorizing completion of real estate purchase contracts and court-supervised option exercises.

headings.title: Petition for discovery of concealed or withheld assets
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes representatives or interested persons to petition the court alleging wrongful withholding of estate assets.

headings.title: Civil procedure rules and right to jury trial
headings.reviewNote: Subjects summons, pleadings, and subsequent asset discovery proceedings to the Missouri Rules of Civil Procedure and authorizes any party to demand a jury trial.

headings.title: Determination of title, delivery order, and money judgment
headings.reviewNote: Directs determining property interests, ordering delivery enforced by attachment, and entering money judgments with interest and damages (excluding attorney fees) if property was disposed of or wrongfully detained.

headings.title: Joinder of additional parties and personal representative
headings.reviewNote: Permits ordering additional parties brought in by amended or supplemental petition and mandates joining the estate's personal representative if not already named.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.340 governing asset discovery petitions, civil procedure rules and jury trial rights, title/delivery/money-judgment orders, and joinder of additional parties and the personal representative (source notes cite 1987 Pilla).

headings.title: Six-month nonclaim statute of limitations
headings.reviewNote: Bars all claims against decedents not filed within six months after first published notice of letters.

headings.title: Six-month notice requirement for pending or revived actions
headings.reviewNote: Bars recovery out of administered assets on judgments under sections 473.363 or 473.367 unless written notice or a timely claim is filed in probate within six months of first publication.

headings.title: Enforcement of mortgages, pledges, and specified liens
headings.reviewNote: Preserves actions to enforce mortgages, pledges, or other liens on estate property, while requiring attachment, judgment, and execution liens to be enforced under chapter 473.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.360 governing the six-month nonclaim bar, six-month notice for pending or revived actions, and preservation of mortgage, pledge, and statutory lien enforcement.

headings.title: Substitution in pending actions deemed claim filing
headings.reviewNote: Deems pending lawsuits against decedents duly filed claims upon timely substitution of the personal representative.

headings.title: Ninety-day listing and notice of pending actions
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a verified list of known pending actions and notifying adverse parties and court clerks within ninety days, without affecting the section 473.360 nonclaim period or imposing failure-to-notify liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.363 governing substitution in pending actions as filed claims and the 90-day listing and notice of pending actions without affecting nonclaim periods.

headings.title: Establishing claims by court judgment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes creditors to establish claims by obtaining final civil judgments against personal representatives.

headings.title: Time judgment or decree is deemed filed
headings.reviewNote: Deems a judgment or decree filed under section 473.360 when a copy is filed in the probate division, except where notice was filed under sections 473.363 or 473.367.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.370 governing establishing claims by court judgment and when a filed judgment or decree is deemed filed under section 473.360.

headings.title: Written form and sworn verification of claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires claims other than administration expenses to be in writing, state nature and amount, and be signed by the claimant or knowledgeable person stating all credits and offsets were given.

headings.title: Attachment of written instruments and endorsements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates attaching original instruments or copies and explaining any lost or destroyed instruments.

headings.title: Competent evidence required prior to payment
headings.reviewNote: Precludes treating claim statements as proof and requires establishing validity by competent evidence.

headings.title: Immediate clerk notice to personal representative
headings.reviewNote: Directs the probate clerk to transmit copies of filed claims immediately to representatives or their counsel.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.380 governing claim written forms, instrument attachments, independent evidentiary proof, and clerk notice duties.

headings.title: Public assistance debt due state or county
headings.reviewNote: Establishes post-1978 public assistance expenditures as statutory debts due the state from decedent recipient estates.

headings.title: Claim allowance under statutory classification
headings.reviewNote: Directs allowance of public assistance reimbursement claims under sixth or eighth priority statutory debt classes.

headings.title: Hardship exceptions for collection of assistance debt
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits filing claims where collection costs exceed recovery or collection harms surviving spouses or dependents.

headings.title: Competent evidence and computerized agency records
headings.reviewNote: Establishes computerized state agency disbursement records as competent and substantial evidence of assistance payments.

headings.title: Compliance with federal Medicaid recovery limits
headings.reviewNote: Subordinates state recovery claims to federal statutory prohibitions and remits federal equity shares.

headings.title: MO HealthNet release prerequisite to closing estate
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a release from MO HealthNet evidencing debt satisfaction or waiver prior to closing probate estates.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.398 establishing public assistance estate debts, claim priority, hardship exemptions, computerized proof, federal rules, and mandatory MO HealthNet estate closing releases.

headings.title: Defined terms for spousal assistance recovery
headings.reviewNote: Defines assistance, obligor estate, recipient, and state agency for spousal assistance recovery claims.

headings.title: Claim against deceased recipient spouse's estate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes recovering recipient assistance debts from the estate of the surviving spouse, capped at marital resources.

headings.title: Agency initiation of claim on state debt
headings.reviewNote: Empowers state agencies that provided assistance to initiate probate claims against the obligor spouse's estate.

headings.title: Spousal abandonment affirmative defense
headings.reviewNote: Establishes voluntary abandonment by the recipient spouse more than two years prior to assistance as a valid defense.

headings.title: Right of setoff for prior estate recoveries
headings.reviewNote: Grants obligor estates a setoff right for any amounts previously recovered from the recipient's estate under section 473.398.

headings.title: Compliance with federal funding statutory restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Bars claims under this section where collection would violate federal statutes governing assistance programs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.399 defining statutory terms, spousal assistance estate claims, agency initiation, abandonment defenses, setoffs, and federal limits (source notes cite 2008 Shuh and Bruce federal preemption holdings).

headings.title: Court adjudication and judgment effect of allowance
headings.reviewNote: Requires claims to be allowed by court order, giving allowance the legal effect of an interest-bearing judgment.

headings.title: Representative payment without prior court allowance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes personal representatives to pay claims without prior court order subject to surcharge upon written exceptions.

headings.title: Allowance of administration expense claims
headings.reviewNote: Permits allowing claims for administration expenses on application or in the court's discretion at any settlement regardless of prior payment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.403 governing court claim allowance and judgment effect, payment by representatives without prior court allowance subject to exceptions, and administration expense allowances.

headings.title: Six-month claim payment grace period
headings.reviewNote: Relieves personal representatives from paying estate claims until six months after first publication of notice.

headings.title: Mandatory payment after six months or sufficient assets
headings.reviewNote: Directs the personal representative to pay consented or finally allowed claims after six months from first publication or when sufficient assets appear to pay all claims.

headings.title: Report and court order upon insolvency or insufficient funds
headings.reviewNote: Permits the personal representative to report suspected insolvency, insufficient funds, or good cause to the court and apply for necessary orders.

headings.title: Payment of any claim with consent of all interested parties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a personal representative to pay any claim at any time with the consent of all interested parties, notwithstanding sections 473.360, 473.363, and 473.367.

headings.title: Timely filed or acknowledged claim not barred for lack of service
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no claim timely filed with the court or acknowledged in writing by the representative shall be barred for lack of service on the representative within the nonclaim period.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 473.433 governing the six-month payment grace period, mandatory payment thereafter, insolvency reports, payment with all interested parties' consent, and non-bar of timely filed/acknowledged claims lacking service.

headings.title: Petition alleging sale of real estate under junior judgment
headings.reviewNote: Requires the personal representative to file a petition detailing the junior judgment sale, plaintiff, purchaser, and all prior judgments or attachments when multi-lien real estate is sold.

headings.title: Service of petition and show-cause order for resale
headings.reviewNote: Requires serving the petition on the junior judgment plaintiff and purchaser with an order to show cause why the real estate should not be sold to pay prior judgments or attachments.

headings.title: Purchaser's three-month privilege to pay prior judgments
headings.reviewNote: Grants the junior-sale purchaser three months after petition service to pay prior judgments, or the section 473.360 period for attachments.

headings.title: Resale free of junior judgment title upon nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Directs selling the real estate free from the junior judgment sale title if the purchaser fails to pay prior judgments within the subsection 3 period.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.443 governing petitions after junior judgment sales, service and show-cause resale orders, purchasers' three-month payment privilege, and resale free of junior title.

headings.title: One-year ultimate nonclaim statute of repose
headings.reviewNote: Bars all claims against decedents not filed within one year after death, regardless of notice publication.

headings.title: Preservation of mortgage, pledge, and statutory lien enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Preserves actions to enforce mortgages, pledges, or other liens on estate property, while requiring attachment, judgment, and execution liens to be enforced under probate law.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.444 establishing the one-year nonclaim bar from death (source notes cite 2004 Cahill and 2010 Houska) and preserving mortgage, pledge, and statutory lien enforcement.

headings.title: Sale by acting executor or administrator with will annexed
headings.reviewNote: Requires the acting executor or administrator with the will annexed to make sales and conveyances under a will if no other person is appointed or the appointee fails or refuses to act.

headings.title: Court supervision and exercise of personal testamentary power
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to direct a successor or other person to exercise a personal testamentary power of sale and to supervise its exercise to effectuate the testator's will.

headings.title: Election to proceed under will power or statutory law
headings.reviewNote: Permits an executor given testamentary power to sell, mortgage, lease, or exchange property to proceed either under that power or under statutory provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.457 governing sales by acting executors or administrators with will annexed, court supervision of personal testamentary powers, and election between will power and statutory procedures.

headings.title: Purposes for selling, mortgaging, leasing, or exchanging property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court-ordered sale, mortgage, lease, or exchange of real or personal property to pay claims, allowances, legacies, administration expenses, taxes, or for best interests or burdensome distribution.

headings.title: Sale or mortgage necessary for estate distribution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes selling or mortgaging real and personal property under court order when necessary to make distribution of the estate or any part thereof.

headings.title: Exhaustion of personal property before real estate sale
headings.reviewNote: Requires exhausting estate personal property before ordering real estate sold to pay estate obligations unless the court orders otherwise.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.460 governing purposes for selling, mortgaging, leasing, or exchanging real or personal property, sales or mortgages for distribution, and exhausting personal property first.

headings.title: Testamentary reservation of specific property
headings.reviewNote: Requires reserving specific property from sale to pay debts when directed by will, unless other assets are insufficient.

headings.title: Reservation of specific devises unless needed under section 473.620
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits selling specific devises in any case unless necessary in accordance with section 473.620 abatement rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.467 governing testamentary reservations from sale and reservation of specific devises unless required under section 473.620.

headings.title: Court motion to sell real estate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the probate court on its own motion to order the sale of real estate when representatives fail to apply.

headings.title: Notice and hearing on court-initiated sale
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice and hearing before ordering real estate sales initiated by court motion.

headings.title: Order directing representative to execute sale
headings.reviewNote: Directs personal representatives to execute public or private sales in accordance with court orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.490 authorizing court-initiated real estate sales, hearing notice, and sale execution orders.

headings.title: Petition contents for real estate transactions
headings.reviewNote: Requires petitions describing property, reasons for disposition, alternative relief, and lien particulars.

headings.title: Notice of hearing to heirs and devisees
headings.reviewNote: Requires mailed or published notice to interested heirs and devisees specifying hearing dates and terms.

headings.title: Court order for sale, mortgage, or lease
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes orders approving real estate dispositions and permitting sales subject to existing mortgages with consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.493 detailing transaction petition contents, hearing notices, and judicial disposition orders.

headings.title: Location and auction procedure for public sale
headings.reviewNote: Requires public real estate sales to occur at the courthouse door or court-designated location by open auction.

headings.title: Public adjournment of sale up to three months
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes public adjournment of real estate sales from time to time, capped at a three-month total delay.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.510 governing open auction sale locations and three-month adjournment limitations.

headings.title: Ten-day verified report of sale filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing verified reports of real estate transactions within ten days, with appraisals and non-interest affidavits.

headings.title: Written objections to confirmation of sale
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any person interested in the estate to file written objections to confirmation of the sale.

headings.title: Judicial examination, approval, and deed order
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to approve advantageous, compliant sales and order delivery of proper deeds or conveyances.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.513 governing ten-day sale report filings, written objections, and judicial approval orders.

headings.title: Execution and delivery of conveyance
headings.reviewNote: Directs representatives to execute, acknowledge, and deliver conveyances or leases upon court approval orders.

headings.title: Required recitals in sale or mortgage deeds
headings.reviewNote: Requires recitals referencing court orders, appraisements, advertisements, proceedings, and consideration in deeds.

headings.title: Required contents of representative leases
headings.reviewNote: Requires representative leases to contain court recitals and grant possession and use of decedent rights.

headings.title: Legal effect and evidentiary presumption of deed
headings.reviewNote: Provides that approved representative conveyances pass complete decedent title and serve as evidence of recited facts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.520 governing deed execution, required statutory recitals, lease contents, and legal evidentiary title effects.

headings.title: Annual settlement filing schedule
headings.reviewNote: Requires personal representatives to file annual statements of account with vouchers on anniversary dates of letters.

headings.title: Mandatory triggers for final settlement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates final settlements after six months and ten days from first notice, ten days after revocation, or upon resignation.

headings.title: Continuances and time extensions for good cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to extend settlement deadlines or permit late filings without penalty for good cause shown.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.540 establishing annual accounting schedules, final settlement deadlines, and good cause time extensions.

headings.title: Detailed statement of collections, interest, and expenditures
headings.reviewNote: Requires accounting for all receipts, collections, interest earned, and expenditures with itemized vouchers.

headings.title: Electronic checks and bank records as vouchers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes electronic check copies and bank records as competent voucher evidence for claimed disbursements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.543 governing itemized account disclosures and voucher requirements including electronic check proofs.

headings.title: Accounting by successor or legal representative
headings.reviewNote: Requires removed representatives, resigning fiduciaries, or executors of deceased representatives to file final accountings.

headings.title: Taxing costs and waiver of publication for no-estate representative
headings.reviewNote: Taxes court costs to the original estate and waives section 473.033 publication when letters are issued for a deceased representative leaving no estate solely to make settlement.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.603 governing final settlement and delivery upon representative termination and taxing costs/waiving publication for no-estate deceased representatives.

headings.title: Order to file final settlement and contempt commitment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering a representative, legal representative, or other person to file a required final settlement and enforcing compliance by contempt attachment and commitment.

headings.title: Ascertainment of assets, judgment against sureties, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ascertaining estate property held by a delinquent representative, entering judgment against the representative and sureties, and enforcing by execution or attachment and commitment.

headings.title: Ten-day notice and hearing on application
headings.reviewNote: Requires setting the application for hearing with at least ten days' clerk notice to all affected parties served per section 472.100.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.607 governing orders and contempt to compel final settlements, ascertaining assets and surety judgments, and ten-day hearing notice.

headings.title: Petition for partial distribution prior to final settlement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes personal representatives or distributees to petition for partial distribution after expiration of nonclaim periods.

headings.title: Discretionary notice and conclusive effect of partial distribution
headings.reviewNote: Permits decreeing partial distribution with or without notice as ordered, making a noticed decree conclusive except where other distributees or claimants are deprived of their fair share.

headings.title: Refunding bond requirement for distributees
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to require distributees to post refunding bonds guaranteeing return of assets if needed for debts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.613 authorizing partial distributions, hearing requirements, and refunding bond protections.

headings.title: Final settlement and petition for final distribution
headings.reviewNote: Requires the executor or administrator, after the claim filing period expires and when the estate can be closed, to file final settlement and petition for final distribution.

headings.title: Required contents and property descriptions in decree
headings.reviewNote: Requires decrees to name distributees, specify proportions, describe remaining property, and identify advancements.

headings.title: Distribution of share when distributee dies before distribution
headings.reviewNote: Permits distributing a deceased distributee's share to their personal representative or, if no administration is needed, under sections 473.090 to 473.107.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of decree and third-party grantee rights
headings.reviewNote: Makes the final distribution decree conclusive as to successors and interests (subject to appeal and reopening) without affecting transfers by or rights of grantees from heirs or devisees.

headings.title: Mandatory recording of decree affecting real property
headings.reviewNote: Requires recording a certified copy of any final distribution decree including real property in every county where the real property lies, at estate expense.

headings.title: Prompt distribution of assets after order entry
headings.reviewNote: Requires the personal representative to make prompt distribution of estate assets after entry of any distribution order, subject to section 473.618.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.617 governing final settlement/distribution petitions, required decree contents, deceased distributee shares, conclusive effect and grantee rights, real-property recording, and prompt distribution.

headings.title: Judgment creditor request for notice of distribution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a distributee's judgment creditor to file an acknowledged request for notice of partial or final distribution and serve it on the personal representative or counsel.

headings.title: Twenty-day certified mail notice and liability for early distribution
headings.reviewNote: Bars distribution to a debtor-distributee until twenty days after mailing certified or registered notice of the distribution date, preserving representative liability against prior garnishment or attachment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.618 governing judgment creditor notice requests and the twenty-day certified mail notice prerequisite prior to distribution.

headings.title: Statutory order of asset appropriation and abatement
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes the order of property abatement starting with intestate assets, residuary devises, general devises, and specific devises.

headings.title: Proportional abatement within devise classes
headings.reviewNote: Mandates proportional abatement among devises of the same class subject to testamentary provisions.

headings.title: Apportionment to preserve testamentary intent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to modify statutory abatement orders when necessary to give effect to the testator's plan.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.620 establishing the statutory abatement hierarchy, proportional class abatement, and modifications preserving testamentary intent.

headings.title: Interest accrual after twelve months from death
headings.reviewNote: Directs general legacies to bear statutory legal interest starting twelve months after death unless litigation intervenes.

headings.title: Specific devises include investment yield
headings.reviewNote: Allocates dividends, interest, and yields from specifically devised securities and instruments directly to the legatee.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.633 establishing interest rules for general legacies and allocating yields to specific devises.

headings.title: Trustee appointment to collect and partition personalty
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing a designated person to collect and distribute personal property that cannot be divided in kind.

headings.title: Bond requirement for partition trustee
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to require the designated partition trustee to execute a performance bond with sureties.

headings.title: Discharge of trustee upon application
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes discharging the partition trustee upon petition of the trustee or a majority of heirs when no longer beneficial.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.643 governing trustee appointments for indivisible personalty, trustee bonds, and discharge procedures.

headings.title: Authorized recipients of distribution payments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes distributions to distributees, attorneys-in-fact under valid powers of attorney, or court-appointed fiduciaries.

headings.title: Distribution to life beneficiary trust accounts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes distributions to specialized trust accounts established under sections 402.199 to 402.208 for qualifying beneficiaries.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.657 detailing authorized distribution payees and distributions to statutory beneficiary trust accounts.

headings.title: Petition to determine heirs after one year
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes heirs to file petitions to determine heirship when no administration or will was commenced within one year of death.

headings.title: Notice of hearing on heirship petition
headings.reviewNote: Directs notice of the heirship hearing to all persons claiming property interests and unknown heirs.

headings.title: Publication and certified mail service of notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires four consecutive weeks of published notice and certified mail delivery to named interested parties.

headings.title: Decree of heirship and conclusive evidentiary effect
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to enter a conclusive decree determining heirs and their respective shares in decedent property.

headings.title: Mandatory recording of decree in county deed records
headings.reviewNote: Requires recording certified copies of heirship decrees in county deed records where real property is situated.

headings.title: Prospective applicability to deaths after July 13, 1989
headings.reviewNote: Applies heirship determination procedures to estates of persons dying on or after July 13, 1989.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.663 establishing heirship determination petitions, hearing notices, publication rules, conclusive decrees, deed recordation, and effective date scope.

headings.title: Service methods on foreign personal representatives
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service of process on foreign personal representatives by registered, certified, or ordinary mail.

headings.title: Response deadline following service of process
headings.reviewNote: Grants foreign personal representatives thirty days after postmark or delivery to file responsive pleadings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.689 establishing mail service procedures for foreign representatives and response deadlines.

headings.title: Substitution of resurrected decedent in pending suits
headings.reviewNote: Directs substituting the supposed decedent for the administrator in pending actions upon proof that the person is alive.

headings.title: Opening prior judgments and real estate lien after substitution
headings.reviewNote: Permits opening judgments recovered against the administrator upon sworn defense affidavit within three months, and makes judgments after substitution a lien on the supposed decedent's county real estate.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.717 governing substitution of a supposed decedent in pending suits and opening prior judgments and real estate liens.

headings.title: Election, four-year term, and candidate qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Provides for quadrennial election of county public administrators (except City of St. Louis) as ex officio guardians/conservators and sets age, residency, voter, tax, and surety affidavit qualifications.

headings.title: Constitutional oath, $10,000 minimum bond, and annual statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires taking the oath and posting at least a $10,000 bond by January first, filing an annual sworn property statement, and providing additional security within twenty days on demand or facing removal.

headings.title: Public officer status, discretionary duties, and county indemnity
headings.reviewNote: Designates public administrators as public officers with discretionary duties under sections 475.120 and 475.343, and requires county defense and indemnification for in-scope acts or omissions.

headings.title: County official status for salaried public administrators
headings.reviewNote: Deems salaried public administrators county officials after January 1, 2001 for section 50.333 purposes, subject to section 473.742 minimum salary requirements.

headings.title: Appointment of public administrator for City of St. Louis
headings.reviewNote: Directs appointment of the City of St. Louis public administrator by a majority of twenty-second judicial circuit judges en banc under subsection 1 qualifications, preserving the incumbent's post-August 28, 2013 term.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 473.730 governing county public administrator elections and qualifications, constitutional oath and $10,000 minimum bond, public officer status and county indemnity, salaried county official status, and City of St. Louis judicial appointment.

headings.title: County duty to furnish separate public administrator office
headings.reviewNote: Requires county commissions to provide suitable separate office space, equipment, and supplies for public administrators.

headings.title: Secretarial staffing and state reimbursement in specified counties
headings.reviewNote: Entitles public administrators in specified mental hospital or habilitation center counties with 100+ cases to a state-reimbursed secretary at court clerk II pay and an acting substitute during absences.

headings.title: Discretionary county and city provision of clerical personnel
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes county and St. Louis City governing bodies to provide non-deputy clerical personnel when business reasonably requires it for public welfare.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.737 governing county and St. Louis City offices, state-reimbursed secretarial staffing in specified counties, and discretionary clerical personnel.

headings.title: Annual compensation and salary commission increase in noncharter counties
headings.reviewNote: Provides $4,000 annual compensation to first-class noncharter public administrators earning under $25,000 in fees, and allows requesting up to a $10,000 increase if fees are under $45,000.

headings.title: Certification prerequisite for training compensation
headings.reviewNote: Conditions training expense reimbursements on filing certificates of attendance with county treasurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.739 governing annual compensation and salary commission increases in noncharter first class counties and 20-hour training certification and expense reimbursement.

headings.title: Annual salary option in Boone and Clay counties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes setting annual salaries in lieu of fees for public administrators in Boone and Clay counties.

headings.title: Fee collection and remittance to county treasury
headings.reviewNote: Requires public administrators on salary to collect statutory fees and remit them to the county general revenue fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.740 establishing salaried compensation in Boone and Clay counties and fee remittance to county treasuries.

headings.title: Discretionary additional compensation up to $34,000 cap
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes governing bodies of specified first-class noncharter counties to grant additional county-funded compensation capping total public administrator pay at $34,000 per annum.

headings.title: Pre-February first establishment of additional compensation
headings.reviewNote: Directs governing bodies to set additional compensation prior to February first in general election years for public administrators, payable throughout the ensuing term.

headings.title: Termination upon supreme court opinion requiring state payment
headings.reviewNote: Terminates additional compensation authority under this section if a Missouri Supreme Court opinion would obligate the state to pay it.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.741 governing discretionary additional county compensation up to $34,000, pre-February first establishment, and termination if a supreme court opinion requires state payment.

headings.title: Written election between salary and fees and 2024 default
headings.reviewNote: Requires second-, third-, and fourth-class county and St. Louis City public administrators to elect salary or fees in writing within thirty days (irrevocable if salary), with salary deemed elected for first terms starting on or after January 1, 2024.

headings.title: Caseload and assessed valuation salary schedules and training
headings.reviewNote: Sets minimum salaries by average open letters, full-time assessed valuation schedules (including post-August 28, 2026 schedule), St. Louis City $65,000 minimum, and 20-hour annual training requirement for $2,000 of pay.

headings.title: Dual guardian and conservator appointment counted as two letters
headings.reviewNote: Provides that appointment as both guardian and conservator for the same ward or protectee counts as two letters.

headings.title: Salary commission option for assessed valuation schedule
headings.reviewNote: Allows a salary commission by majority vote to irrevocably elect paying a public administrator under the subdivision (5) assessed valuation schedule instead of average open letters.

headings.title: Initial salary determination and two-year workload adjustments
headings.reviewNote: Bases initial salary on the two-year prior letter average and adjusts minimum salaries only upon a new term after two consecutive years in a different workload bracket.

headings.title: Deposit of salaried administrator fees in county or city treasury
headings.reviewNote: Requires depositing all fees collected by a salaried public administrator in the county treasury or with the City of St. Louis treasurer.

headings.title: LAGERS retirement option for fee-based first-class administrators
headings.reviewNote: Permits fee-based public administrators in noncharter first-class counties under 100,000 population to elect to join LAGERS under sections 70.600 to 70.755.

headings.title: Separate counting and definitions of guardianship and conservatorship letters
headings.reviewNote: Counts letters of guardianship and conservatorship separately and defines both terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsection headings for 473.742 governing salary/fee elections (2024 default), caseload and assessed valuation salary schedules (including post-August 28, 2026 schedule) and training, dual-letter counting, salary commission options, two-year workload adjustments, fee deposits, LAGERS eligibility, and letter definitions.

headings.title: Definitions imported from section 475.010
headings.reviewNote: Adopts the section 475.010 definitions of conservator, guardian, protectee, and ward for section 473.748.

headings.title: Unenforceability of clauses making administrator personally liable
headings.reviewNote: Renders unenforceable any contract term requiring a public administrator acting as guardian or conservator to personally pay, assume, or guarantee a ward's or protectee's debt or account.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.748 importing section 475.010 definitions and rendering unenforceable contract clauses imposing personal debt liability on public administrators.

headings.title: One-year final settlement and delivery in fee-retention counties
headings.reviewNote: Requires fee-retention public administrators to file final settlements within one year after a successor qualifies and deliver unclosed estates within sixty days of the court's one-year turnover order.

headings.title: Pre-departure delivery and filings in salaried counties
headings.reviewNote: Requires salaried public administrators to deliver property and make required filings prior to leaving office.

headings.title: Court-ordered turnover to successor and annual account filing
headings.reviewNote: Directs turning over estate administration to the successor upon court order and requires the successor to file a copy of each estate's annual account and be charged accordingly.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.767 governing one-year final settlements and turnover in fee-retention counties, pre-departure filings in salaried counties, and court-ordered turnover and annual accounts.

headings.title: Appointment and certification of deputies in first class counties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes public administrators in any first class county to appoint deputies with annually renewable court certificates of appointment, terminable by filed notice.

headings.title: Compensation of deputies from county treasury or fees
headings.reviewNote: Governs deputy compensation paid from the county treasury in large counties or from administrator fees elsewhere.

headings.title: Delegated ministerial and banking powers of deputies
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates authorized ministerial duties including taking asset possession, banking transactions, and safe deposit access.

headings.title: Limitation precluding exercise of fiduciary discretion
headings.reviewNote: Precludes deputies from exercising discretionary powers required by law to be performed personally by fiduciaries.

headings.title: Delegation of statutory duties and legal document execution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes delegating specific statutory duties and empowers attorney-deputies to execute inventories and pleadings.

headings.reviewNote: Authorizes public administrators in non-first-class counties to appoint deputies with annual court certificates.

headings.title: Deputy compensation paid from administrator fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires deputy compensation in non-first-class counties to be paid by administrators out of earned fees.

headings.title: Enumerated ministerial and safe deposit powers
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates permissible ministerial duties including asset collection, bank accounts, and safe deposit access.
