headings.title: Delegation of statutory duties in non-first-class counties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes public administrators in non-first-class counties to delegate sections 473.743 and 475.120/475.130/475.343 duties to deputies and court-document execution to licensed attorney deputies.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 473.771 governing deputy appointment in non-first-class counties, fee compensation, ministerial powers, fiduciary discretion limits, and statutory duty/attorney-deputy delegation.

headings.title: Classification of administrator staff as county employees
headings.reviewNote: Classifies deputies and clerical staff appointed by public administrators as county employees for benefits and civil service.

headings.title: County or city-funded full-time staff for fifty-case administrators
headings.reviewNote: Permits providing full-time staff paid by the county or City of St. Louis to each public administrator with fifty or more cases.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.775 classifying full-time public administrator staff as county or St. Louis City employees and authorizing paid full-time staff for fifty-case administrators.

headings.title: Independent administration authorized by will
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes independent administration when expressly provided in decedent's will, unless court finds good cause.

headings.title: Distributee consent for independent administration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes independent administration without will direction upon filing written consents of all adult distributees.

headings.title: Independent administration with disabled heirs and no guardian ad litem
headings.reviewNote: Permits granting independent letters when one or more required heirs or devisees are under disability and all others consent, while prohibiting appointment of a guardian ad litem for this purpose.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.780 establishing independent administration under wills, distributee consent procedures, and independent letters.

headings.title: Independent status and Missouri Prudent Investor Act compliance
headings.reviewNote: Defines independent personal representative status while independent letters remain in force and requires post-August 28, 1996 actions to comply with the Missouri Prudent Investor Act.

headings.title: Expeditious settlement without court order and court invocation
headings.reviewNote: Directs expeditious settlement and distribution without court adjudication, order, or direction, while permitting invocation of court jurisdiction to resolve estate questions.

headings.title: Mandatory attorney advice for nonattorney independent representative
headings.reviewNote: Requires an independent personal representative who is not a Missouri bar member to secure a non-salaried attorney's advice on nine enumerated legal areas of estate administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.787 governing independent status and Prudent Investor Act compliance, expeditious settlement without court order, and mandatory attorney advice for nonattorney representatives.

headings.title: Employment of qualified disinterested appraisers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes independent personal representatives to employ qualified disinterested appraisers to determine date-of-death fair market value of doubtful assets, listing each appraiser on the inventory.

headings.title: Employment and compensation of attorneys, accountants, and tax specialists
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes employing attorneys, CPAs, Treasury-permitted tax specialists, and independent accountants for tax returns and accounting records with reasonable compensation paid from the estate.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.797 governing employment of disinterested appraisers and employment and compensation of attorneys, accountants, and tax specialists.

headings.title: Protection of third persons dealing in good faith
headings.reviewNote: Protects persons dealing in good faith with independent representatives as if the representative properly exercised power.

headings.title: Protection of bona fide purchasers and representative damage liability
headings.reviewNote: Bars setting aside transfers to bona fide purchasers for value on unreasonableness grounds while allowing interested persons to recover resulting damages from the independent representative.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 473.811 governing protection of good-faith third parties dealing for value without duty of inquiry, and protection of bona fide purchasers with representative damage liability.

headings.title: Representative personal liability on estate contracts
headings.reviewNote: Shields personal representatives from personal liability on contracts properly entered into in a fiduciary capacity unless otherwise agreed.

headings.title: Personal liability for torts committed during administration
headings.reviewNote: Holds representatives personally liable for torts committed during administration only if personally at fault.

headings.title: Assertion of claims against representative in fiduciary capacity
headings.reviewNote: Requires contract and tort claims arising from administration to be asserted against representatives in fiduciary capacities.

headings.title: Determination of liability between estate and representative
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes resolving indemnity and liability disputes between representatives and estates in probate accounting proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 473.820 establishing contract liability limits, personal fault standards for torts, fiduciary capacity claims, and estate indemnity determinations.

headings.title: Reasonable compensation for independent representative
headings.reviewNote: Entitles independent personal representatives to reasonable compensation from estate assets for services rendered.

headings.title: Renunciation of testamentary compensation and supervised conversion
headings.reviewNote: Permits renouncing will-specified compensation before qualifying only by also renouncing independent administration under section 473.780(1), converting to supervised administration unless authorized under subsection 2 or 3.

headings.title: Reasonable attorney fees and court approval above statutory minimum
headings.reviewNote: Entitles the independent representative's attorney to reasonable compensation, bars representative or attorney fees above the section 473.153 minimum without court authorization, and makes the schedule prima facie evidence.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.823 governing reasonable representative compensation and fee renunciation, renunciation of will compensation and supervised conversion, and attorney fees with court approval above the statutory minimum.

headings.title: Petition to restrain independent representative
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes interested persons to petition the court to restrain independent representatives from taking specified actions.

headings.title: Ten-day hearing deadline and court-directed notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires setting a restraining petition for hearing within ten days unless agreed otherwise, with court-directed notice to the representative, counsel, and named defendants.

headings.title: Application of probate code and supreme court injunction rules
headings.reviewNote: Directs that restraining order procedures follow the probate code and the Missouri Supreme Court rule relating to injunctions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.830 governing ex parte restraining petitions, ten-day hearing deadlines and notice, and applicability of probate code and supreme court injunction rules.

headings.title: Petition for revocation of independent administration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes interested persons or the court on its own motion to petition for revocation of independent administration.

headings.title: Interest determination, hearing order, and nominal-interest dismissal
headings.reviewNote: Requires determining petitioner's interest, ordering a noticed hearing (with optional answer deadlines) if more than nominal, and permitting dismissal on motion if nominal.

headings.title: Interlocutory orders to protect assets pending hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes interlocutory orders deemed necessary to protect estate assets pending a full hearing or to determine whether administration has been proper.

headings.title: Post-hearing orders, supervised conversion, removal, and surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering supervised administration, conditional denial, or other relief, and permits removal and section 473.207 judgment against the representative and sureties if actions caused estate loss.

headings.title: Continuation of administration under supervised probate provisions
headings.reviewNote: Directs that estate administration proceed under chapter 473 provisions outside sections 473.780 to 473.843 after an order revoking independent administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 473.833 governing petitions to revoke independent administration, interest determinations and nominal dismissals, interlocutory protective orders, post-hearing orders/removal/surcharge, and supervised continuation.

headings.title: Completion and discharge after six months and ten days
headings.reviewNote: Permits an independent personal representative, unless prohibited by court order, to complete administration and obtain discharge under this section after six months and ten days from first published notice.

headings.title: Required contents of statement of account and published notice
headings.reviewNote: Specifies six required elements of the filed statement of account, including complete accounting, payment status, proposed distribution schedule, 20-day objection notice, and four-week published notice.

headings.title: Mailed notice of statement to interested parties
headings.reviewNote: Requires mailing statements of account, inventories, and notice of twenty-day objection periods to interested persons.

headings.title: Judicial audit on timely objection and unobjected distribution
headings.reviewNote: Directs distribution without audit if no objections are filed, and requires hearing and audit upon timely objections.

headings.title: Proof of mailing filed with statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing signed proof of mailing listing all persons and addresses notified under this section.

headings.title: Automatic discharge after six months absent proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Discharges independent personal representatives from further liability if no court proceedings are filed within six months.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 473.840 governing completion and discharge after six months and ten days, statement of account contents and published notice, mailed notices, 20-day objection audits, proof of mailing, and automatic six-month discharge.

headings.title: Instrument or deed of distribution in kind
headings.reviewNote: Requires independent personal representatives to execute deeds or instruments of distribution assigning assets to distributees.

headings.title: Conclusive evidentiary effect of distribution deed
headings.reviewNote: Makes deeds of distribution conclusive evidence of distributee title against all interested persons, subject to improper distribution recovery.

headings.title: Distributee liability for improper distribution
headings.reviewNote: Requires distributees or claimants receiving improper distributions to return assets and income, or their fair value.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 473.844 governing instruments of distribution in kind, conclusive title evidence, and distributee restitution for improper distributions.
